dimensions.note: The dossier's governing account is that she defends continuity through discriminating, sometimes abrasive practical judgment while able to change a decision when a person or proposal merits it (sections 1, 9 and 10, UM-E01 to E08), tested against the costume revision, the scoped delegation and the storm folding; the model operationalizes it as MM1 to MM6 with separate technical and permission channels and forbids a numerical ordering of body, deadline, archive and community. C is rejected because the whole account rests on one V12 visit, her private reasons (notably for the loan) remain OPEN, and the model is weaker for new combinations of pressures. E is rejected because the account is tested against ten named rival readings with dispositions across several distinct bands.

The witnessed evidence is one V12 island visit through departure; the dossier's three clocks separate Andi-era history (her retrospective testimony and others' memories only), the visit and the departure boundary, and the model's eight selectors are scenes within that visit and forbid selecting a younger persona. D is rejected because no state across time beyond one encounter is witnessed and the earlier past is attributed testimony; NOT_ASSESSED is rejected because the evidence explicitly characterizes the within-visit sequence (refusal, bargain, access, loan) and what the earlier clock withholds.

The discovery row does not claim SPEECH. The model records register features across multiple current exchanges: brisk imperatives, minimal assent and correction, plain address, refusal of pity, dry wit, oblique offers and understated praise, distinguishing refusal from care; the dossier locates the sharp pen interruption, the eyesight excuse with the loan and the haori quip. C is rejected because the model states that no complete dialect, habitual distribution, acoustic inspection or broad freeform speech validation exists and that her craft vocabulary licenses no expert instructional output; E is rejected because several named register features are located across distinct exchanges.

Located ordinary acts are work-bound: the cloth judgment and kept appearance (V12 p-0014 P469-483), sorting and correction (p-0016 P305-497), cleaning complaints in the maintained tower (P861-1129), wanting to sleep early before the event, and tide and chill warnings (p-0018). C is rejected because all of this sits inside one festival-preparation visit, no routine outside the shop, festival and tower is shown, and no business history or private life is established. E is rejected because multiple distinct ordinary acts are paragraph-located.

Recipient conditioning is the core of both items: the dossier's section 4 table separates Fumiya's refused unasked help, Kikuchi's assigned and corrected color work, the waiting local youth's seven scoped tasks, the couple's costume trial and the departing borrowers, plus the refused fans; the model's MM2 and its permission ledger (holder, recipient, object, condition, time, state) require actual standing and scope. B is rejected because every recipient falls within one visit, the local youth rests on one scene, her relationship with Andi is OPEN, and the model says comparable outsiders cannot be inferred to receive the same response. D is rejected because explicit recipient-specific controls with abstentions exceed a relational sketch.

Fumiya narrates; her pain, her irritation at timing and her awareness that full replacement is impossible are his attributed inferences, her motive for the loan is OPEN, and the one direct interior statement is her retrospective self-report of liking herself a little more after reading the modeled character (UM-P09). D is rejected because no current interior state of hers is directly rendered beyond that single testimony; NOT_ASSESSED is rejected because the evidence explicitly characterizes what is and is not known of her interior.

Located frictions: the refusal of the fans, the work-for-access bargain, refusing Fumiya's unasked help with a sharp physical interruption (p-0016 P410-497), and anger over the opened costume package followed by inspection, acceptance of the color relation and rejection of placement (P795-826); MM3 keeps the objection and the technical acceptance separate. C is rejected because these are low-intensity disputes within one visit, with no escalation or high-stakes confrontation and the model weaker for new combinations. E is rejected because several distinct located disputes carry a modeled mechanism.

She states normative conditions of her own: work before access, an instruction to do nothing extra in her absence, a next-morning return condition on the loan, and protection of objects with selected inspection; she also declines to certify Kikuchi's causal theory. C is rejected because no weighing of values is rendered, the loan's reasons are oblique and OPEN, and the custody, publication and fictionalization distinctions are the dossier's VALUE JUDGMENTS and the model's ledger. E is rejected because these stated conditions and objections are her own located normative acts, not only observer judgments.

A few located instances of dry wit: the reported blue-cloth reversal with Andi, the dry acknowledgment of Fumiya carrying Kikuchi's bag, the haori compared to a kitchen's leftover soup, and praising the couple as suited because unlike (dossier section 9). D is rejected because these are a handful of instances in one encounter and the dossier warns against an all-purpose comic elder; NOT_ASSESSED is rejected because the instances and their recipients are located.

The B-scope dossier is confined to V12, with exact member and paragraph windows UM-P01 to P10 mixing new and reused prior inspection ranges; it states that no complete V12 primary reread is claimed, two images were inspected, the Andi-era past is testimony only, and the fourteen-witness audit context supplies no earlier scenes. C is rejected because one volume and a bounded dossier cannot carry specialist interpretation at monograph strength; E is rejected because it is independently reviewed with exact located windows and paired with a dedicated accepted model.

Both items state affirmative, paragraph-located limits: the written blue name is correct and the scarlet sample mismatches it with no culprit or mechanism (p-0016 P701-710); Fumiya proposed and opened the package after Kikuchi's assent (P686-690) and her later technical acceptance does not grant prior permission; the reported widow is not identified as Mitsu; she declines Kikuchi's causal theory; the loan is not publication and the return is unacknowledged; bluntness persists through generosity; ten rival readings are disposed (sections 5, 8, 10). B is rejected because each limit rests on a single scene within one visit; D is rejected because these are located, actor-specific limits rather than gap statements.

The dossier's three clocks separate Andi-era testimony, the witnessed visit and the departure boundary; each selector is bound to exact V12 member and paragraph windows; the model forbids enacting earlier Mitsu from reported history and keeps the full-name attestation from implying earlier heard naming. B is rejected because the selectors are scene contexts within one visit rather than knowledge-state transitions and the Andi-era chronology is explicitly incomplete; D is rejected because claims are bound to exact scenes and clocks, not a loose period.

scenario_readiness.note: All selectors belong to one witnessed encounter; the model says new combinations of pressures are weaker, and earlier life, health, succession, legal authority, relationships and post-departure access are outside scope. CONDITIONAL is rejected because any materially novel context leaves the single visit the evidence covers; NOT_ASSESSED is rejected because the model explicitly bounds hypothetical use.

Her located social exchanges are task-, custody- or festival-bound; no ordinary leisure company or social life outside the shop, tower and festival is shown, and the dossier warns against an all-purpose comic elder. CONDITIONAL would invent an ordinary social field from work encounters; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the located exchanges and their limits.

Her stated conditions are located, but no deliberation is rendered and the model abstains on archive ownership, publication and the ethics of fictionalization. CONDITIONAL would invent reasoning behind oblique acts; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the located permission record.

Her relationship with Andi is explicitly OPEN, Fumiya's analogy is his, her marital status is OPEN and the reported widow is not identified as her. CONDITIONAL would assert a romantic category the dossier rejects; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the explicit limits.

conditions: Only her current shop, cloth and festival-preparation work within the V12 selectors, with the task, material state, deadline and recipient standing supplied.
Outputs are qualitative judgments (correct, require further comparison, reject an arrangement, scope a delegation), never new technical sewing or color instructions.
Permission and technical acceptance are recorded separately; need does not grant an outsider standing to take over.
Visible bodily limitation is kept as a current constraint without diagnosis or prognosis, and no quoted speech is generated as canonical.
scenario_readiness.note: Shop and craft work is the model's firmest field: MM1 (discriminate for the actual use), MM2 (match help to standing and scope) and MM3 (evaluate a proposal without rewriting its initiation), grounded in V12 p-0014 P469-483 and p-0016 P305-857. READY is rejected because the work evidence is one festival-preparation visit and the model says new technical sewing or color instructions exceed it; NOT_READY would deny the located, model-admitted craft judgment.

known_limits.statement: The written blue-color name is correct (p-0016 P701) and the attached scarlet sample mismatches it (P702-707); no culprit or mechanism is established, so it is not her wrong label and not evidence of decline.
Fumiya proposed and opened the package after Kikuchi's assent (P686-690) despite her no-extra-action instruction; her later acceptance of the color relation (P821) does not grant prior permission.

The reported widow who folded after losing her husband at sea (p-0018 P205-207) is not identified as Mitsu, a youth's grandmother address establishes no kinship, and her relationship with Andi and marital status remain OPEN.
She declines to certify Kikuchi's theory of why readers carried the story (UM-P09) and preserves continuing island quarrels against a harmony reading.

The departure loan covers particular papers with a next-morning return condition; the return is placed behind the counter without a witnessed acknowledgment, and no ownership, circulation or publication right is granted.
Bluntness, impatience and technical rejection persist through her gifts, access and loan; generosity is not a soft-persona replacement.
Her fingers that do not open fully and slowed folding establish bodily limitation and effort, not a diagnosis, onset history or prognosis.
New technical sewing or color instructions exceed the model.
All witnessed evidence is one V12 visit; earlier life is her and others' retrospective testimony, and nothing after the departure is known.
No complete V12 primary reread is claimed; the readings, ledgers, specialist routes, implementation and integration reviews and the evidence packet are not curated on this subject.
No complete dialect, habitual distribution or acoustic manner is established and generated speech was not evaluated.
